shorts_extract.hook: Why you feel a crisp two-beat phone buzz inside an empty pocket while your phone sits across the room.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Rothberg's 2010 BMJ hospital survey (68% of doctors & nurses) + Powers & Corlett's 2017 Yale Science fMRI hallucination study.
shorts_extract.twist: Vibrate mode trains top-down priors on that exact inch of skin — moving the phone to a bag resets your touch map.
